title: I Spend My Life Criticising AI. These Five Stopped Me.
headings: **1. An ECG that spots heart disease in under two seconds**
**2. Satellites that see a fire five metres across**
**3. A mammogram that may also be a heart scan**
**4. A model that predicts deforestation six months ahead**
**5. A model reading two centuries of pressed plants**
coverage: opening + one cue-ranked passage + headings; partial inspection

passages.text: I write about AI going wrong most weeks, and doing only that makes me

**My book goes underneath all of this.** *Slow AI* is about the question this post is a corner of: knowing when to use these tools, and when to leave them alone. It was a #1 Amazon bestseller in Education.
